title: Reusable project examples
summary: One confined examples/<id> source can serve multiple pages and locales with generated source tabs, assets and dependency receipts.
invariants: index.html is required; index.css, index.js and assets are optional.
An example uses either an id or inline code, never both.
Traversal, symlink, hardlink, case collision, unknown types, invalid UTF-8 and size overflow fail closed.
Changing a referenced shared example requires a complete build.
